elements.text: General Principles governing Global Food Safety Law (Bevilacqua 2015)

elements.body: '… a systematic way of gathering, evaluating and recording information which would lead to recommendations, positions or actions in response to an identified hazard.' WTO (2000). Four components: risk policy, risk assessment, risk management and risk communication. See SPS Agreement and CAC Procedural Manual.

Enables decision-makers to adopt precautionary measures when scientific evidence about an environmental or human health hazard is uncertain and the stakes are high. Not formally defined as such but its requirements are laid out in Art 7 Reg 178/2002/EC.
Rule of law is fluid — decision-making should be coherent with the purposes, adequate to reach its tasks, rationally motivated, and directed to cause the least harm to conflicting interests.
Adequacy between the legislative prescriptions and the administrative decision …
